ओटीटी की दुनिया से आ गई है एकदम मसालेदार खबर! 🔥
हरलीन सेठी ने अमेज़न प्राइम वीडियो की नई अनटाइटल्ड सीरीज़ की स्टार कास्ट जॉइन कर ली है। 🎬
इस प्रोजेक्ट में उनके साथ दिव्येन्दु शर्मा, अभिषेक Banerjee और प्रतीक गांधी भी नजर आने वाले हैं। 🌟
प्रोडक्शन के करीब एक सूत्र का दावा है कि हरलीन ने शो की शूटिंग भी शुरू कर दी है। 🎥
यह एक एम्पायर-स्टाइल ड्रामा सीरीज़ है जो पावर, एम्बिशन और रिश्तों की कहानियों को टटोलेगी। 👑
डायरेक्टर भानु प्रताप सिंह इस बड़े प्रोजेक्ट को डायरेक्ट कर रहे हैं और कहानी-किरदारों पर अभी पर्दा रखा गया है। 🤫
बता दें कि हाल ही में हरलीन Netflix की Shaque में दिखी थीं और पहले Broken But Beautiful, Kohrra जैसे प्रोजेक्ट्स कर चुकी हैं। 📺
क्या आप इन चारों शानदार कलाकारों को एक साथ स्क्रीन पर देखने के लिए बेताब हैं? 🤔

ctx.text:
Harleen Sethi has joined the cast of an upcoming untitled series for Amazon Prime Video, which also features Mirzapur actors Divyenndu Sharma and Abhishek Banerjee. Actor Pratik Gandhi is also part of the project, which is being directed by Bhanu Pratap Singh.
The series is described as an empire-style drama and is expected to explore themes of power, ambition and relationships. Details about the characters and storyline are currently under wraps.
According to a source close to the production, Harleen has already begun shooting for the series. “Harleen has joined the cast of much-awaited Amazon Prime Video's untitled Empire-style drama and commenced the shoot for the show. Bringing together a talented ensemble cast like Abhishek, Divyendu, Pratik, and now Harleen joining the cast would make for an interesting dynamic when the most credible actors come together for a project this ambitious,” the source said.
The source also spoke about Harleen’s recent work, adding, “With Shaque's massive success, it will be a treat for the audiences to see Harleen in another gripping role. With the shoot now underway, we are thrilled for audiences to experience it.”
Harleen was recently seen in Netflix’s Shaque: Trust No One . Her other streaming credits include Broken But Beautiful , Kohrra , Doctors , Bad Cop and The Gone Game .
Meanwhile, Divyenndu Sharma and Abhishek Banerjee have recently reunited in Mirzapur: The Movie , following their association with the popular streaming franchise. Pratik Gandhi, who has worked across films and series, also has projects including Hansal Mehta’s Gandhi and Madgaon Express 2 in his lineup.
The upcoming series marks another collaboration between a cast of actors known for their work across films and streaming platforms. Bhanu Pratap Singh, who has been associated with Dharma Productions, is directing the project.
The series is currently in production, while further details about its storyline, characters and release date are awaited.
